_about: Challenge-mode election (List 20 #189) — the operating system for #70's Dial C. The election is stored ONCE, in #96's meta section (the save-header seat #70 named); the #98 licence renders it as a standing and stores nothing. The fragment instances no mode: names, count and band deltas are the owner's OPEN ruling, inherited from Dial C.

bands.rule: a mode selects among PRE-AUTHORED band-set variants (Dial A) in the #7/encounter files — authored data, never scaled to the visitor, never adjusted by results; canon locked levels keep under every mode

change.audit: the history is append-only — records earned under an earlier election stay attributed to it

event.centreId: #132 centre where the change was serviced
event.seat: the save history beside #106's tombstones (facts kept with #12's history)

change.rule: changeable ONLY at a care centre (#132), keeper-serviced — never mid-route, never mid-battle, never silently, never by the game

election.renderedBy: #98 licence, as a derived standing (proposed into #98's home) — the licence stores identity only and gains no field
election.storedIn: #96 save meta section — one fact, one seat, no second copy

modes: OPEN — the mode set (names, count, deltas) is an owner ruling; zero modes instanced
neverTouches: outcome math (#70's law — outcome math is fixed and auditable)
win/loss history (no input to any band, ever)
the Dark Forest depths — emptiness and weather NONE are canon, not a band
the show lane (autonomous-action doctrine; a show fight has no difficulty)
refusal: hidden rubber-banding is REFUSED — #70's written refusal of mechanism (1), restated with its force. (The commissioning brief cited '#76'; #76 is web export. The refusal lives in #70.)
